thread:
ida: FYI I'm seeing a cluster of CI failures for today's rollout — deploy-bot reports 'multipart finalize: backend size mismatch' and some runners stuck waiting on cache lease at ~13:20 UTC.

vik: pasted runner log: ```ERROR finalize: expected=9876543 got=9876480; status=ok-from-proxy``` looks like truncation on finalize.

ops: two immediate choices: (A) delay the change window and investigate storage finalization; (B) pin to last-green and promote now to avoid customer impact. Ops prefers B if safe.

deploy-bot: promote request queued -> upload step failed: 412 Precondition Failed: lease conflict (owner not found). retrying 1/4.

release-manager: change window in 90 minutes for partner demo. leaning to pin to last-green build (sha: 77aa22) and open an incident ticket. will add a clear note in the release notes.

sre-oncall: quick mitigation: throttle object-store writers and increase finalize timeout. patch: kubectl -n infra patch cm objstore -p '{"data":{"max_writers":"4","finalize_timeout_s":"90"}}' I'll monitor error_rate for 10m.

ida: ok do the throttle AND prepare to pin. if metrics look stable in 6m we promote pinned build. @vik can you run manual promote and watch canaries?

vik: ack. running manual promote to sha 77aa22 now. will abort on any artifact verification failures.

deploy-bot: manual promote started by vik at 1746101290; step1 snapshot -> success; step2 route update -> success; step3 canary rollout -> 3/3 healthy at 1746101350; step4 finalize -> pending.

release-manager: created INC-10345 to track object-store finalize failures and linked to release board. release note line drafted: "Promoted previous green build (77aa22) due to artifact finalize failures; investigation INC-10345."

ida: finalize reported success at 1746101398. thanks everyone — keeping the ticket open until we understand root cause.
